entries.meaningZh: 重音节奏性（旧式少用词；另补诗律名词义）
entries.en: Her reading brought out the accentuality of the verse through sharply marked stresses.
entries.zh: 她在朗读中鲜明地突出重音，表现出了这首诗的重音节奏性。

entries.meaningZh: 按重音节奏地（据完整accentual父条及MW明确副词另补）
entries.en: The students scanned the poem accentually rather than counting every syllable.
entries.zh: 学生们按重音节奏分析这首诗，而不是逐个计算音节。

entries.meaningZh: 可接受性（另选一般评价义，不是适众性）
entries.en: The committee questioned the acceptableness of asking volunteers to work through the night.
entries.zh: 委员会质疑要求志愿者通宵工作是否可以接受。

entries.meaningZh: 公认地（少用；据完整accepted父条及MW明确副词另补）
entries.en: She was acceptedly the best chess player in the club.
entries.zh: 俱乐部里公认她是最出色的棋手。

entries.meaningZh: 以接纳的态度（据完整accepting父条及MW明确副词另补）
entries.en: He listened acceptingly as she described her doubts about the plan.
entries.zh: 他以接纳的态度听她讲述自己对该计划的疑虑。

entries.meaningZh: 辅件，配件（accessary的复数；较少用拼法）
entries.en: Inside the case, she found two spare lenses and several other accessaries.
entries.zh: 箱子里，她发现了两个备用镜头和几件其他配件。

entries.meaningZh: 以补充方式（accessorily的变体；另补副词义）
entries.en: The small chart explains accessarily why the water level rose after the storm.
entries.zh: 这张小图表以补充方式解释了暴风雨后水位为什么上升。

entries.meaningZh: 从犯参与（accessoriness的变体；另补抽象名词义）
entries.en: The prosecutor tried to establish his accessariness to the theft.
entries.zh: 检方试图证明他参与了那起盗窃案。

entries.meaningZh: 易到达程度（据完整accessible父条及MW明确名词另补）
entries.en: The library's accessibleness improved when a bus stop opened beside it.
entries.zh: 旁边新设了公交站后，去那家图书馆更方便了。

entries.meaningZh: 荣誉提名（欧洲学校奖项中接近获奖者的表彰；另补精确奖项范围）
entries.en: In the old school record, she received an accessit for her essay but not the prize.
entries.zh: 那份旧学校记录记载，她的文章获得了荣誉提名，但没有赢得奖项。

entries.meaningZh: 附属地，附从地（此例指补充方式）
entries.en: The photographs show accessorily how the damaged roof was repaired.
entries.zh: 这些照片以补充方式展示了受损屋顶是如何修复的。

entries.meaningZh: 参与某事的情况（尤指参与犯罪；另补抽象名词义）
entries.en: Her alleged accessoriness to the plot was a central issue in the trial.
entries.zh: 她涉嫌参与这场阴谋，是审判中的一个核心问题。

entries.meaningZh: 偶然论（认为事件可以没有原因的哲学观点；另补学说义）
entries.en: His defence of accidentalism challenged her claim that every event must have a cause.
entries.zh: 他为偶然论辩护，质疑了她关于每件事都必有原因的主张。

entries.meaningZh: 偶然性（据完整accidental父条及MW明确名词另补）
entries.en: The accidentalness of their meeting made the reunion even more moving.
entries.zh: 他们偶然相遇，使这次重逢更加动人。

entries.meaningZh: 赞扬者（据完整acclaim父条及MW明确名词另补）
entries.en: Once a loud acclaimer of the plan, he now questioned its cost.
entries.zh: 他曾大力赞扬这个计划，如今却对其费用提出质疑。

entries.meaningZh: 能适应新环境的（据完整acclimate父条及直接词典另补）
entries.en: The gardener considered the young plant acclimatable to the cooler greenhouse.
entries.zh: 园丁认为，那株幼苗能够适应较凉的温室环境。

entries.meaningZh: 可适应新气候或环境的（据完整acclimatize父条及直接词典另补）
entries.en: The keeper wondered whether the rescued animal was acclimatizable to the island's wet climate.
entries.zh: 饲养员想知道，那只获救的动物能否适应岛上潮湿的气候。

entries.meaningZh: 适应新环境的人（另补直接词典的人物义）
entries.en: An unusually quick acclimatizer, she soon felt at home in the mountain town.
entries.zh: 她适应新环境很快，不久就在那座山城感到自在。

entries.meaningZh: 乐于通融地（据完整accommodating父条及MW明确副词另补）
entries.en: The shopkeeper accommodatingly kept the parcel until I could collect it after work.
entries.zh: 店主很通融，把包裹留着，等我下班后再来取。

entries.meaningZh: 住宿方面的（据完整accommodation父条及直接词典另补所选义）
entries.en: The organiser compared the accommodational options before booking rooms for the visiting choir.
entries.zh: 组织者为来访合唱团订房前，比较了住宿方面的几种选择。

entries.meaningZh: 乐于通融的态度（据完整accommodative父条及MW明确名词另补）
entries.en: Her accommodativeness made it easier for the two families to agree on a meeting time.
entries.zh: 她乐于通融的态度，让两家人更容易商定见面的时间。

entries.meaningZh: 提供方便的人（accommodator的复数；另选帮助者义）
entries.en: As patient accommodators, the volunteers kept finding ways to help visitors whose plans had changed.
entries.zh: 作为耐心提供帮助的人，志愿者们不断设法帮助那些行程有变的来访者。

entries.meaningZh: 完成任务的人（据完整accomplish父条及MW明确名词另补）
entries.en: The team needed a steady accomplisher, not another person full of grand promises.
entries.zh: 团队需要一个踏实完成任务的人，而不是又一个满口宏大承诺的人。

entries.meaningZh: 账目（account的古语变体；另补所选名词义）
entries.en: In the historical novel, the steward checks the accompt before paying the carpenter.
entries.zh: 历史小说中，管家在付钱给木匠前核对账目。

entries.meaningZh: 弦乐器的定弦音组（另补音乐技术义，不是泛指基调）
entries.en: The violinist checked the accordatura before rehearsing the new piece.
entries.zh: 小提琴手在排练新曲目前，检查了各弦的定弦音。

entries.meaningZh: 可问责性（据完整accountable父条及MW明确名词另补）
entries.en: Publishing the club's spending records increased the treasurer's accountableness to its members.
entries.zh: 公布俱乐部的开支记录，提高了财务主管对会员的可问责性。

entries.meaningZh: 以可问责的方式（另选承担责任义，不是原释可说明地）
entries.en: The charity promised to use the donations accountably and publish a full record of its spending.
entries.zh: 那家慈善机构承诺以可问责的方式使用捐款，并公布完整的开支记录。

entries.meaningZh: 可获认证的（据完整accredit父条及MW明确形容词另补）
entries.en: The review panel considered the new training programme accreditable once its assessment rules were clarified.
entries.zh: 评审小组认为，只要明确考核规则，这个新培训项目就具备获得认证的条件。

entries.meaningZh: 教育质量认证机构（另选机构义，不是信用证申请人）
entries.en: The college sent its revised report to the accreditor.
entries.zh: 学院把修订后的报告送交了认证机构。

entries.meaningZh: 吸积天体（此例指从伴星接收物质的恒星；另选天文学义）
entries.en: The model tracks material flowing from the donor star to the accretor.
entries.zh: 模型追踪物质从供体恒星流向吸积恒星的过程。

entries.meaningZh: 侵占，擅取权力（据完整accroach父条及直接词典明确名词另补）
entries.en: In the historical drama, the council condemns the duke's accroachment of royal powers.
entries.zh: 历史剧中，议会谴责了公爵对王权的侵夺。

entries.meaningZh: 可累积的（此例指假期；据完整accrue父条及MW明确形容词另补）
entries.en: The handbook lists the maximum accruable leave for each grade.
entries.zh: 手册列出了各职级可累积的假期上限。

entries.meaningZh: 文化适应的（据完整acculturation父条及直接词典另补）
entries.en: The interviews explored the acculturational challenges faced by students studying abroad for the first time.
entries.zh: 这些访谈探讨了首次出国学习的学生面临的文化适应挑战。
